purpose: 150-row raw-corpus holdout for manual annotation and locked evaluation of the full LLM annotation pipeline.
sampling_rule: Country/language-stratified random sample from raw corpus: 50 CHI, 50 JPN, 50 KOR. Within each country, sample 17 short, 17 medium, and 16 long posts using within-country text-length tertiles. Rows matching existing human-annotated IDs were excluded from the eval sampling frame to avoid leakage.
type_distribution_note: Before manual annotation, true labels such as E1/E2/E3, C1-C5, and CSM domains are unknown in the raw corpus. Length band is used as the available pre-annotation balance variable; label distribution will be measured after manual annotation.
annotation_field_note: Manual annotators may use Chinese as the working language. evidence_span_original must be copied exactly from original_title/original_text/text_clean, while surface_text_working is an annotator-facing Chinese gloss and is not required to appear verbatim in the source text. working_language records the language of that gloss.
